title: 第5章 浮光掠影第6章 食人花的暗算
content_zh:
第五章浮光掠影
看着自己手上过千的积分，一种莫名的感觉涌上心头：自己是不是偶尔也改改行去做做强盗呢？
同时带上了那枚戒指：“古铜戒指伤害增加0—1需要装备条件：力量8点。可以兑换200积分。
“恩，还不错，加了一点攻击伤害。”
捡起自己扔掉的木剑，叶宇轩继续在森林中摸索着。
在这森林中，许多变异魔鹿在树荫下静静的吃着青草，叶宇轩没有理会这些变异魔鹿一直向前走，大约走了10多分钟，众人眼前一亮，一片空旷的土地出现在他们眼前。
在那快土地上，密密麻麻的睡着几十只毒蜘蛛。一些枯萎的老树上，几只乌鸦一般的鸟儿在他们的头上呱呱叫着，显得有些凄凉。
叶宇轩有心试试这种毒蜘蛛的实力。光芒正大的走了上去。一下就引了四只过来。这还是他见好就收，小心翼翼的结果，如果他在向前走一点，将会有十只左右的毒蜘蛛围上来。
没有多余的动作，叶宇轩左右闪烁着，挥舞着自己的武器向着离自己最近的毒蜘蛛奔去。本来就移动缓慢的毒蜘蛛遇上叶宇轩的快剑如何能够闪避，一下就减少了4分之一还多一点的生命。
而同时叶宇轩也感觉左臂突然一痛，原来是毒蜘蛛的尖抓此到了自己。看了眼自己目前的生命，255/260.减少了5点。
感觉还行，能够抗住，因此叶宇轩也不准备闪避，欲要在另外三只到来之前先干掉他。
眼看身前的毒蜘蛛已经空血，再来一剑就可以送他上西天了。就着之个时候，毒蜘蛛突然四肢猛然一台。大嘴一张，一口绿色的毒液喷洒到了叶宇轩的身体上。接着叶宇轩就发现自己的生命从250，以每秒两点的速度在减少。一直持续了5秒。
而此时另外三只也一起冲了上来。知道硬拼撑不了多久的叶宇轩，果断的放弃了正面对抗，开始了传奇上最经典的走位砍杀。
凭借着他军人的伸手，加上邪恶空间的强化，使他每次都能给轻易的躲闪掉身前毒蜘蛛的攻击，偶然被击中也是因为身后另外两只毒蜘蛛。
又杀死一只。叶宇轩只减少了10点生命。而这10点生命，还是因为叶宇轩的粗心大意和初次联系走位没有适应的结果。否则根本不会被击中。
有了刚才杀死毒蜘蛛的经验。叶宇轩跟着刚才的感觉，又和最后两只毒蜘蛛厮杀起来。没有给他们任何反击的几乎，另外两只毒蜘蛛就一命呜呼的倒下了，留给叶宇轩一滩东西。
四个毒蜘蛛虽然个数不多，但是给予叶宇轩的回报却是不少，平均一个毒蜘蛛有40点积分，40个就是160，再加上两瓶小型金疮药，一瓶小型魔法药，加一条金项链，可以说收获真的很好。
金项链：使佩戴者敏捷+1需要装备条件：敏捷在10点以上。可兑换120积分。带上戒指，叶宇轩继续使用着刚才的战术，开始清剿这块土地上的毒蜘蛛。
大约过了1个小时左右的时间，叶宇轩来回跑跑已经杀死了20多只。收获了800点积分，5瓶小型金疮药，2瓶小型魔法药。和一个白银手镯。
白银手镯，使佩戴者精神+1需要装备条件：敏捷在8点以上。可兑换130点积分。

看着半天的辛勤努力，仅仅爆出两件装备，叶宇轩不由的感叹，不管什么地方，装备的爆率都是一等一的低啊。
又是半小时过去了，叶宇轩坚持着砍杀完最后13个毒蜘蛛终于清剿玩了整个空地的毒蜘蛛。一共收获了1300多点积分，加两件装备。再加上原来的做强盗得到的东西。
叶宇轩一个有5件装备，2500点积分。看着完成的任务，叶宇轩活动了下胫骨，踏上了返回的村庄的路途。
在路上仔细的回忆着这次战斗的情景，叶宇轩发现在战斗当中生命恢复不是一分钟一点，而是将近5分钟才恢复一点。可见金疮药的重要性。
来到武馆，叶宇轩轻轻的推开木门，走进去。看着依旧一动不动坐在哪里的武师道：“老师，我回来了，任务完成了。”
听到叶宇轩的话，心情没有丝毫的起伏，缓缓睁开眼睛，站起身来。走到他的身边淡淡道：“不错，”
一个提示在叶宇轩的脑海中想起，是否愿意交出1000点积分。
到了这个地步怎么可能选中否呢？“是。”叶宇轩默默的喊道。
“好，既然你通过了我的考验，那么就能够获得我的奖励。这是技能表格，你从中随便选中一个，作为你的奖励，其他的则需要支付足够的金钱，才能够继续修炼。
说完，把技能表递给叶宇轩，便再次沉默。
叶宇轩及武师绝学：《浮光掠影》。
没有疑问，“我选择《浮光掠影》。”叶宇轩赶紧说道。在一次试炼当中，武师那神乎其神的速度让他羡慕，让他吃惊。再说，在着恐怖的邪恶空间，有什么比逃命技能，更加好的呢？
《浮光掠影》学习条件：武师之徒，5000点积分（可减免）。学习者符合条件，可以学习。只见武师右手轻轻一挥，一道白光便没入了叶宇轩的体内，
《浮光掠影》B级技能，等级1：传奇世界中的特色技能，只可在特定人物那里获得。增加百分之30的移动速度，持续时间1分钟。同时可在移动中分出一个残影，迷惑敌人的视线。影子持续时间1秒。
尝到甜头的叶宇轩，对技能现在是爱的不能自拔，微微思考了一下，想到自己的力量，敏捷，体力都超过正常人，心中立即有了定论。以后走武士这样的道路，想好之后，便点击了《基本剑术》。
《基本剑术》学习条件：1000点积分，学习者符合条件，是否学习。
“是。”既然选择了武士之路，叶宇轩也不在后悔，直接点了上去。

Chapter 5 Glimpses
Looking at the over a thousand points in his hand, an inexplicable feeling came to his mind: Did he occasionally change his profession and become a robber?
At the same time, he brought the ring: "The damage of the bronze ring increases by 0-1. It requires equipment conditions: Strength 8 points. It can be exchanged for 200 points.
“恩，还不错，加了一点攻击伤害。 "
Picking up the wooden sword he threw away, Ye Yuxuan continued to fumble in the forest.
In this forest, many mutated demonic deer were quietly eating grass under the shade of the trees. Ye Yuxuan ignored these mutated demonic deer and kept walking forward. After walking for about 10 minutes, everyone's eyes lit up, and an empty land appeared in front of them.
On that fast land, dozens of poisonous spiders were sleeping densely. On some withered old trees, a few crow-like birds were croaking above their heads, looking a little desolate.
叶宇轩有心试试这种毒蜘蛛的实力。光芒正大的走了上去。一下就引了四只过来。 This was the result of his caution and caution. If he moved forward a little, about ten poisonous spiders would surround him.
Without any extra movement, Ye Yuxuan flashed left and right, waving his weapon and running towards the poisonous spider closest to him. How could the poisonous spider, which was originally slow-moving, dodge Ye Yuxuan's fast sword? It lost a quarter or more of its life in one fell swoop.
At the same time, Ye Yuxuan also felt a sudden pain in his left arm. It turned out that the tip of the poisonous spider had scratched him. I took a look at my current life, which was 255/260, reduced by 5 points.
It felt okay and he could resist, so Ye Yuxuan was not prepared to dodge and wanted to kill him before the other three arrived.
Seeing that the poisonous spider in front of him was empty of blood, one more sword strike would send him to the west. At that moment, the poisonous spider's limbs suddenly twitched. He opened his mouth and sprayed a mouthful of green venom onto Ye Yuxuan's body. Then Ye Yuxuan found that his life was decreasing from 250 to 2 points per second. It lasted for 5 seconds.
而此时另外三只也一起冲了上来。 Ye Yuxuan knew that he would not be able to hold on for long, so he decisively gave up the head-on confrontation and started the most classic positional slashing in the legend.
With his military reach and the strengthening of the evil space, he could easily dodge the attacks of the poisonous spiders in front of him every time. He was accidentally hit because of the other two poisonous spiders behind him.
Killed another one.叶宇轩只减少了10点生命。 And these 10 points of life are still the result of Ye Yuxuan's carelessness and failure to adapt to the position during the first contact.否则根本不会被击中。
有了刚才杀死毒蜘蛛的经验。 Ye Yuxuan followed the feeling just now and started fighting with the last two poisonous spiders. Without giving them any chance to fight back, the other two poisonous spiders fell down, leaving Ye Yuxuan with a puddle.
Although the four poisonous spiders are not many in number, they give Ye Yuxuan a lot of rewards. On average, one poisonous spider has 40 points, and 40 is 160. Plus two bottles of small gold sore medicine, a bottle of small magic medicine, and a gold necklace, it can be said that the harvest is really good.
Gold Necklace: Increases the wearer's agility by 1. Equipment requirements required: agility of 10 or above. Can be redeemed for 120 points. Putting on the ring, Ye Yuxuan continued to use the tactics just now and began to eliminate the poisonous spiders on the land.
About an hour later, Ye Yuxuan had killed more than 20 animals by running back and forth. I received 800 points, 5 bottles of small golden sore medicine, and 2 bottles of small magic medicine. and a silver bracelet.
A silver bracelet that increases the wearer's spirit by 1. Equipment requirements: agility of 8 or above. Can be redeemed for 130 points.
Seeing that after half a day of hard work, only two pieces of equipment were revealed, Ye Yuxuan couldn't help but sigh, no matter where,The equipment's explosion rate is first-class low.
Another half hour passed, and Ye Yuxuan persisted in killing the last 13 poisonous spiders and finally eliminated the poisonous spiders that had played in the entire open space. A total of more than 1,300 points were gained and two pieces of equipment were added. Plus the original stuff you get from being a robber.
Ye Yuxuan has 5 pieces of equipment and 2,500 points. Looking at the completed task, Ye Yuxuan stretched his shins and set foot on the road back to the village.
While carefully recalling the scene of the battle on the road, Ye Yuxuan discovered that during the battle, his health was not restored a little bit every minute, but it took nearly 5 minutes to restore a little bit. This shows the importance of gold sore medicine.
Arriving at the martial arts hall, Ye Yuxuan gently pushed open the wooden door and walked in. Looking at the martial artist who was still sitting there motionless, he said, "Teacher, I'm back. The mission is completed."
Hearing Ye Yuxuan's words, his mood did not change at all. He slowly opened his eyes and stood up. Walked to his side and said calmly: "Not bad,"
A reminder came to Ye Yuxuan's mind, whether he was willing to hand over 1,000 points.
How could it be possible to choose No at this point? "Yes." Ye Yuxuan shouted silently.
"Okay, since you passed my test, you can get my reward. This is the skill table. You can choose one from it as your reward. For the others, you need to pay enough money to continue practicing.
After saying that, he handed the skill list to Ye Yuxuan and fell silent again.
Ye Yuxuan and the martial arts master's unique skills: "Glimpses".
There is no doubt, "I choose "Glimpse". "Ye Yuxuan said quickly. In a trial, the martial artist's miraculous speed made him envious and surprised him. Besides, in the terrifying evil space, what is better than escape skills?
"Glimpse of Light" learning conditions: Martial Arts Disciple, 5,000 points (can be waived).学习者符合条件，可以学习。 I saw the martial artist wave his right hand lightly, and a white light penetrated into Ye Yuxuan's body.
"Glimpse" B-level skill, level 1: a characteristic skill in the legendary world, which can only be obtained from specific characters. Increase movement speed by 30% for 1 minute. At the same time, an afterimage can be separated during movement to confuse the enemy's sight. Shadow duration is 1 second.
Ye Yuxuan, who had tasted the sweetness, couldn't help but love the skill. He thought about it for a moment, and realized that his strength, agility, and physical strength were all higher than those of normal people, and he immediately came to a conclusion in his heart. After thinking about taking the path of a samurai in the future, I clicked on "Basic Swordsmanship".
"Basic Swordsmanship" learning conditions: 1,000 points, the learner meets the conditions, whether to study or not.
"Yes. "Now that he has chosen the path of a warrior, Ye Yuxuan no longer regrets it and just clicks on it.
